description: Read-only. Discover the right financial parameter by name fragment or group and return each parameter's `code`, English name, group and description. Use this to resolve the `parameterCode` you then pass to `bolagsanalys_get_data` (alongside a `companyId` from `bolagsanalys_list_companies`). Example: nameContains 'revenue', group 'Income statement'. Shared reference data; read-only — never writes.

group.description: Parameter group name to filter by, e.g. 'Income statement'.

lang.description: Language for names/descriptions; English default, 'sv' for Swedish.

pageSize.description: Rows per page (v2 default 50, max 500), e.g. 50.

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields; prefix '-' for descending, e.g. '-name'.

name: bolagsanalys_find_parameter

code.description: Parameter code; pass as parameterCode to bolagsanalys_get_data.

period.description: Reporting period the parameter applies to.

pageSize.description: Rows per page echoed back by v2, e.g. 50.

totalCount.description: Total matching rows across all pages; null/absent when count is skipped.

totalPages.description: Total page count; null/absent when count is skipped.

title: Find a Bolagsanalys parameter
